movie:118412.tagline: This sword is proof that i have lived.

When the unthinkable happens and the bombs come down, the town's residents are thrust into the horrors of nuclear winter.
movie:7012.tagline: They told us it would be impossible to make this movie. They told us it would be impossible for you to watch it. We hope nothing is impossible.
